hero.description: I specialize in React and Next.js. I create modern web applications with a passion for clean code and excellent UX. I transform ideas into functional and beautiful digital products.

about.title: Get to know me
about.subtitle: I'm a web technology enthusiast with years of experience building modern web applications.
about.heading: I create
about.paragraph1: Since 2022, I've been professionally building web applications. I specialize in Next.js with SSR/ISR, creating high-performance VOD platforms, blog systems, and marketplaces generating millions of views monthly.
about.paragraph2: I focus on Core Web Vitals optimization, technical SEO, and internationalization (i18n). My projects achieve perfect performance scores and high search engine visibility.
about.paragraph3: I work both in a team (Take Group) and as a freelancer, delivering solutions for clients from various industries - from media platforms to websites for clinics and trainers.

vod.title: VOD Platform
vod.description: Next.js application for a VOD platform supporting multiple page layouts and language versions. Deployed on thousands of domains, generating millions of views monthly. Perfect Core Web Vitals scores.

blog.title: Blog System
blog.description: Next.js-based blog system with 6 visual themes and multi-language support. Dynamic articles fetched from Headless CMS. Some articles reach hundreds of thousands of views.

takelink.title: B2B Marketplace - takelink.pl
takelink.description: Transactional panel connecting advertisers with a network of publishers. Responsive UI with Radix UI, state management via Zustand, NextAuth.js authentication and pay-by-link payments.

casino.title: Casino Reviews CMS (LPCMS)
casino.description: Front-end layer for casino and games review platform with 8 visual variations. Dynamic comparison tables, ranking systems, and playable game demos integrated with Headless CMS.

podology.title: Landing Page - Podology Clinic
podology.description: Professional website for a podology clinic. Modern design, SEO optimization, responsiveness and fast loading times. Contact form and Google Maps integration.

trainers.title: Trainer Websites
trainers.description: Portfolio of websites for personal and fitness trainers. Optimized for SEO and Core Web Vitals, with booking system and transformation gallery.
